description: THIRD SessionOffer canonical form (ADR-032 revision 4 §3/G3, 2026-10-12): the v2 shape plus the REQUIRED binding fields profile_id (msp1:<64 hex> — the coordinator's pinned exact profile under the project rule) and generation_params_hash (bare 64-hex, the §1 rule-3 canonical preimage). Absence of EITHER fails schema; the base and v2 forms are preserved as data that fails deserialization (session-offer-1/2.json). The serving side compares both against its own pinned config and rejects profile_mismatch / params_mismatch — negotiation-time discovery; verifier-side pinning (stage 4 params, stage 7 profile, §8 commit-time equality) remains the enforcement authority. Unsigned (handshake-authenticated session).
